newsitem.title: FRANCE: MOTOR RACING-ITALIAN TRULLI TO REPLACE INJURED PANIS.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-ITALIAN TRULLI TO REPLACE INJURED PANIS.

text.p: Italian Jarno Trulli has been signed up by the Prost Formula One team to replace Frenchman Olivier Panis who broke both legs in a crash during the Canadian Grand Prix.
Team manager Alain Prost said on Monday the 22-year-old Minardi driver would make his debut with the Prost-Honda team in the French Grand Prix on Sunday.
"I want to thank Giancarlo Minardi for letting Trulli go before the French Grand Prix," Prost said in a statement.
"During tests last week, Jarno Trulli showed he is a fast and reliable driver."
Trulli, in his first season in Formula One racing, said he was delighted to have been invited to join the Prost team.
"I am very proud to drive for a team which can legitimately aim at points every race," said the Italian whose best results so far were ninth places in both the Australian and Argentine Grands Prix.
In Italy, Minardi said Trulli's place with them would be taken by Brazilian test driver Tarso Marques.
